bead.title: Add hybrid async request outcome contract
bead.description: Implement the idempotency/outcome contract needed before async checkpointing. In-scope files: crates/pqueue-engine/src/idempotency.rs, crates/pqueue-engine/src/compose.rs, crates/pqueue-engine/src/command.rs, crates/pqueue-objectlog tests as needed. Add or extend durable per-command outcome metadata so hybrid-async can replay committed results for request_id-bearing client mutations after unknown outcome. Define missing-request_id rejection hooks for hybrid-async where protocol support is absent. Out of scope: SQLite checkpoint worker and server runtime wiring.
bead.acceptance:
1. `cargo test -p pqueue-engine idempotency -- --nocapture` passes.
2. `cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog hybrid_request_id -- --nocapture` passes.
3. `cargo test -p pqueue-conformance request_id -- --nocapture` passes.
4. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
